tools.name: get_baby_age
tools.description: Get a baby's exact age from a birth date — years, months, weeks, days, totals, zodiac sign, the current and next milestone, and special-day dates (100 days, first birthday, 1000 days). Use for any 'how old is the baby' question instead of computing it yourself.

tools.name: get_milestone_dates
tools.description: Get the exact calendar date of all 25 baby milestones for a given birth date (monthly, special days, and birthdays), each with days_left and whether it is reached. Use this to add baby milestones to a calendar.

tools.name: list_milestones
tools.description: List the 25 baby milestone types this tool knows (name, emoji, day offset from birth, group). No birth date needed. Use get_milestone_dates to turn these into real dates.

tools.name: get_zodiac_sign
tools.description: Get the zodiac sign (Western astrology) for a birth date, with element, nickname, date range, and a guide link.
